note: City of Hebron municipal park at Euclid Ave and 7th St: a shaded strip of pads between the ballfields and a hay meadow, near the pool and the Hebron Sports & Rec complex. The Little Blue River is ~150 m south beyond a wooded bottom, not in view; a walking trail follows it. Picnic shelter. --Claude
summary: City page confirms $25 a night (prices as of 3/3/25), 15 50-amp hookups on 10 cement and 6 grass pads, restrooms with showers, reservations by phone at 402-768-6322; written. Not waterfront confirmed: the pads sit ~140-240 m from the Little Blue behind a wooded bottom. Page silent on dump, water at the site and the 2-week limit (left as stored).
